annotations.title: Get the fix procedure for an incident

description: The reviewed fix procedure of one incident for one operating system. Takes an incident id returned by the other Fixlane tools. Desktop systems (macos, windows, linux) get an agent prompt: a read-only check first, then the fix. Phones (ios, android) get manual steps only.

incident_id.description: Incident id from another Fixlane tool.
incident_id.title: Incident Id
